backlog.title: BUG-001 — G1.4 Throwaway-Survival Blueprint Prompt Compliance
backlog.description: Fix the literal spec deviation where PRP §9.9.2 G1.4 mandates the throwaway-survival instruction in BOTH the Blueprint and Builder prompts, but only the Builder prompt carries it. The Blueprint (Researcher) prompt's gate-construction CRITICAL RULES block enumerates G1.1, G1.2, G1.3, and G1.5 but skips G1.4. This phase adds the missing G1.4 bullet to the Blueprint prompt, mirrors it into the PROMPTS.md reference doc, adds the corresponding test assertion, and includes the optional executor neutralization test-coverage hardening recommended in the PRD.

milestones.title: G1.4 Blueprint Prompt Instruction, Docs Sync & Test Hardening
milestones.description: Add the G1.4 throwaway-survival instruction to PRP_BLUEPRINT_PROMPT, mirror into PROMPTS.md, add the Blueprint G1.4 assertion test, optionally harden executor neutralization test coverage, and verify changeset-level docs accuracy.

tasks.title: Add G1.4 throwaway-survival rule to Blueprint prompt and PROMPTS.md mirror
tasks.description: The core bugfix. Insert a G1.4 throwaway-survival bullet into the PRP_BLUEPRINT_PROMPT's gate-construction CRITICAL RULES block in src/agents/prompts.ts (between the current G1.3 line 292 and G1.5 line 293). Mirror the same bullet into the PROMPTS.md reference doc (between G1.3 line 276 and G1.5 line 277). Add a Blueprint G1.4 assertion test to the existing 'PRP_BLUEPRINT_PROMPT gate monotonicity rules' describe block in tests/unit/agents/prompts.test.ts. The fix is Researcher-facing: it instructs the Researcher to surface throwaway-survival guidance in the generated PRP's coder instructions, so the coder keeps spike/scratch artifacts alive until after validation — fully satisfying the 'Blueprint and Builder prompts MUST' dual-prompt requirement.

subtasks.title: Add G1.4 throwaway-survival bullet to PRP_BLUEPRINT_PROMPT CRITICAL RULES block + mirror to PROMPTS.md + add Blueprint G1.4 test
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/011_5e3dfdb12bd1/bugfix/001_22bcf90e9926/architecture/system_context.md. The Blueprint prompt (PRP_BLUEPRINT_PROMPT, src/agents/prompts.ts lines 182-677) has a CRITICAL RULES block inside '### Step 3: Research Integration' under '**Validation Gates**'. Current bullets: G1.1 (line 290), G1.2 (291), G1.3 (292), G1.5 (293) — G1.4 is absent. The Builder prompt (PRP_BUILDER_PROMPT, line 678+) already has G1.4 at lines 747-765. Spec: spec/16-validation-gates.md line 27 mandates G1.4 in BOTH prompts. The split wrapper src/agents/prompts/prp-blueprint-prompt.ts embeds the monolith via import — no separate file edit needed.
2. INPUT: The existing G1.3 bullet text at src/agents/prompts.ts line 292 as a STYLE TEMPLATE for the new G1.4 bullet. The Builder prompt's G1.4 block (lines 747-765) as a CONTENT REFERENCE for what G1.4 instructs.
3. LOGIC: Follow implicit TDD — first add a failing test case, then implement the fix.
   (a) TEST: In tests/unit/agents/prompts.test.ts, inside the existing describe('PRP_BLUEPRINT_PROMPT gate monotonicity rules (PRD §9.9 REQ-G1)') block (lines 283-309), add a new it() case modeled on the G1.3 test at line 298. Assert: expect(PRP_BLUEPRINT_PROMPT).toContain('G1.4'), and content checks such as toMatch(/throwaway/i) and toMatch(/survive the coder/ or /survive/). This test will FAIL before the prompt edit.
   (b) PROMPT EDIT: In src/agents/prompts.ts, insert a new bullet line between line 292 (G1.3) and line 293 (G1.5). The bullet MUST follow the existing style: a bold-headed, single-paragraph bullet referencing 'PRD §9.9 G1.4'. Because this is the Researcher/Blueprint context (the Researcher constructs PRPs), phrase it as a PRP-construction rule: 'The PRP you generate MUST instruct the Coder Agent not to delete any spike, scratch, or throwaway artifact during its own turn — cleanup happens only after validation passes.' This is distinct from the Builder prompt which addresses the Coder directly. The bullet must use escaped backticks (\`) consistent with the surrounding template literal.
   (c) DOCS MIRROR: In PROMPTS.md, insert the same G1.4 bullet (using regular markdown, NOT escaped backticks) between line 276 (G1.3) and line 277 (G1.5), matching the surrounding markdown style exactly.
   (d) Run: npx vitest run tests/unit/agents/prompts.test.ts — the new test must PASS. Run: npm run typecheck — must exit 0 (prompts.ts is source, included in tsconfig.build.json).
4. OUTPUT: PRP_BLUEPRINT_PROMPT now contains a G1.4 throwaway-survival bullet in its CRITICAL RULES block; PROMPTS.md mirror is updated identically; the new test passes; typecheck is clean.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update PROMPTS.md (lines 276-277) to mirror the G1.4 addition — this rides WITH this subtask, do not create a separate docs subtask. This is the per-file doc update for the file this change directly touches.

tasks.title: Optional executor §9.9 neutralization test-coverage hardening
tasks.description: Per the PRD Recommendations (h2.5): the unit test for the executor's G2.1 gate neutralization currently asserts the skipped/success/exitCode result shape and that BashMCP is NOT called, but does NOT assert that the info-level log message is emitted. Additionally, no integration test exercises the neutralization path through the real BashMCP. This task adds both: (1) a log-reason assertion to the existing neutralization unit test, and (2) one integration test through the real BashMCP path. These harden the existing §9.9 executor coverage.

subtasks.title: Add §9.9 neutralization log-reason assertion to executor neutralization unit test
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/011_5e3dfdb12bd1/bugfix/001_22bcf90e9926/architecture/system_context.md. The executor emits the neutralization log at src/agents/prp-executor.ts line 554: this.#logger.info({ level, description, command }, 'non-monotonic negative-existence gate neutralized — file existence is owned by the task graph / is a cleanup step, not a terminal-state assertion (§9.9)'). The logger is getLogger('PRPExecutor') from src/utils/logger.ts (pino-based, Logger interface with info(obj, msg) overloads). The existing neutralization unit test is at tests/unit/agents/prp-executor.test.ts line 258: it('neutralizes a negated file-existence gate (G2.1)...'). That test file does NOT currently mock the logger module.
2. INPUT: The existing neutralization test setup at tests/unit/agents/prp-executor.test.ts lines 258-316, which already creates a PRP with a '! test -f src/hooks/index.ts' gate and asserts skipped/success/exitCode/execute_bash-not-called.
3. LOGIC: To assert the log message, the logger must be observable. Add a vi.mock for '../../../src/utils/logger.js' at the top of tests/unit/agents/prp-executor.test.ts that returns a spyable logger from getLogger(). The mock should return an object with jest/vi.fn() methods for info, warn, error, debug, trace, fatal, and a child() method that returns itself. Then in the existing neutralization test (or a new adjacent it() case), after executor.execute(), assert that logger.info was called with a message containing 'neutralized' (use expect.objectContaining or check the second arg of the info call). Alternatively, if the existing module-level mock pattern already spies on logger indirectly, add the assertion there. Ensure all existing tests still pass after adding the logger mock — the mock must be compatible with every test in the file.
   Run: npx vitest run tests/unit/agents/prp-executor.test.ts — all tests must pass including the new assertion.
4. OUTPUT: The neutralization test now asserts both the result shape AND that logger.info was called with the §9.9 neutralization reason string. All existing executor unit tests continue to pass.
5. DOCS: none — no user-facing/config/API surface change. This is test-only hardening of an existing code path.

subtasks.title: Add integration test for G2.1 neutralization through the real BashMCP path
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/011_5e3dfdb12bd1/bugfix/001_22bcf90e9926/architecture/system_context.md. The integration test file tests/integration/prp-executor-integration.test.ts uses real createCoderAgent() and real BashMCP but mocks agent.prompt() to avoid LLM calls (lines 1-60). It currently has NO neutralization test. The file already has test patterns for executing real gates (e.g. lines 132-167, 170-229) and skipping manual gates (lines 236-261). The neutralization path (src/agents/prp-executor.ts lines 553-574) runs BEFORE execute_bash is invoked, so a neutralized gate never touches BashMCP — this is verifiable even with real BashMCP.
2. INPUT: The existing integration test setup (mocks for agent-factory, prompts, retry, checkpoint-manager — but real BashMCP). The PRPDocument factory pattern used in the existing tests. The neutralization command forms from spec/16-validation-gates.md §9.9.2 G2.1 ('! test -f X', 'test ! -f X').
3. LOGIC: Add a new it() test in the describe('execute() with real dependencies') block. Create a PRPDocument with a negated-existence gate (e.g. '! test -f src/hooks/index.ts') plus a real executable gate (e.g. 'echo ok'). Mock agent.prompt to return success JSON. Execute via the real executor. Assert: (a) result.outcome is 'success', (b) the neutralized gate's result has skipped:true, success:true, exitCode:null, (c) a real gate in the same PRP was actually executed (its exitCode is not null, proving the real BashMCP path works for non-neutralized gates while the neutralized gate bypasses it). This proves the neutralization works end-to-end through the real executor with real BashMCP — not just through mocked execute_bash.
   Run: npx vitest run tests/integration/prp-executor-integration.test.ts — all tests must pass.
4. OUTPUT: One new integration test that exercises G2.1 neutralization through the real BashMCP code path. All existing integration tests continue to pass.
5. DOCS: none — no user-facing/config/API surface change. This is test-only hardening of an existing code path.
